name: @pipeworx/mcp-dice

tools.name: dice_cities
tools.description: List cities DICE (dice.fm) sells event tickets in, worldwide. Optionally filter by name/country substring. Each city's `id` + `perm_name` is what dice_browse needs. Use this first to resolve a city name to a browse id.

query.description: Optional substring to filter by city name, perm_name, or country name (case-insensitive), e.g. "york", "united kingdom".

tools.name: dice_browse
tools.description: Live events on sale in one city on DICE (dice.fm), optionally filtered by category (e.g. "DJ", "Gigs", "Comedy", "Theatre"). Returns event name, status (on-sale/sold-out/etc), dates, venue, and starting price. Pass a city name or perm_name — it is resolved via dice_cities internally.

city.description: City name or perm_name, e.g. "New York", "new_york", "London".

category.description: Optional category name or id to filter by, e.g. "DJ", "Comedy", "music:dj". Matched case-insensitively against DICE's own filter list.

tools.name: dice_event
tools.description: Full detail for one DICE event: description, venue + address, dates, starting price, billed lineup (artist names), and age/content highlights. Needs the event id from dice_browse.

event_id.description: DICE event id, from dice_browse's `id` field, e.g. "6ac3bcdb7577c3000123e527".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dice forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dice pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
